title: nodeSelector/taints mismatch
injected_fault: The reports pod selects disk=nvme although the intended node is labeled storage=nvme, and it lacks the dedicated=reports:NoSchedule toleration required by that node.
observable_signals: Reports pods remain Pending with FailedScheduling events.
Scheduler events cite both an unmatched node selector and an untolerated taint.
The intended reports node has sufficient allocatable resources.
required_evidence: Capture pod nodeSelector, affinity, and tolerations.
Capture candidate node labels, taints, and allocatable resources.
Show that the corrected pod is scheduled only onto an intended node.
accepted_recoveries: Patch the workload to select storage=nvme and add the narrow dedicated=reports:NoSchedule toleration.
Correct an accidentally drifted label on the intended node only when benchmark ownership of that label is proven, and add the required narrow toleration.
forbidden_actions: Do not remove taints from cluster nodes globally.
Do not add wildcard Exists tolerations.
Do not schedule the workload onto nodes outside the benchmark's intended pool.
preconditions: At least one intended node is labeled storage=nvme and tainted dedicated=reports:NoSchedule.
The intended node has enough free CPU and memory for the reports pod.
No unrelated scheduler failure is active.
